data.name: Astro beasts
data.detailed_description:
In Astro Beasts, you and your friends play as battle-ready animals who have become the last line of defense against an alien invasion. Cats, dogs, and other furry heroes grab their weapons and fight to survive waves of monsters, where every minute becomes more dangerous and more fun!

Each character has its own unique characteristics, making the game more interesting and varied!

During combat, you can build defenses directly on the arena: raise walls, place mines, and deploy turrets. One player holds back the monsters with firepower, another reinforces the position, a third lures enemies into traps, while the fourth covers the team with turrets and mines.

Each run is a chaotic mix of shooting, tactics, and team survival. Upgrade your characters, combine weapons and structures, cover each other, and decide what matters most right now: massive damage, strong defense, or even more turrets and barricades.

Features

Cooperative Arena Survival Shooter

Fight alien hordes together and cover each other through increasingly dangerous waves.

Cute Animals with Big Guns

Play as dogs, cats, and other adorable heroes saving the world from a monster invasion.

Build During Combat

Raise walls, place mines, and deploy turrets to reshape the arena around your strategy.

Team-Based Strategies

Split roles: someone holds the front line, someone builds defenses, someone clears crowds, and someone saves everyone at the last moment.

Weapons, Upgrades, and Structures

Create different builds and combine abilities with defensive constructions.

Mini-Games

Complete challenges to upgrade your weapons or earn additional bonuses.

Waves of Alien Monsters

The longer you survive, the greater the pressure, and the more every decision matters.

Fast Runs and High Replayability

Try new character combinations, tactics, weapons, and ways to survive when everything goes into a fluffy disaster zone.
